content:
**Wine** is an alcoholic beverage in *Fallout 76*.

A Falmouth Winery merlot, vintage 2060.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, wine is initially crafted as fermentable wine, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented.

Wine can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.
